messages:
Maria - Partnerships: Quick sync — we need to finalize the SI Field Toolkit localization & ops checklist before next week's partner demo. Who's owning translations, region builds, and the demo image rollout?
Raj - SI Programs: I can own translations + approval flow. plan: vendor auto-translate -> human QA for key docs. ETA 3 days.
Denise - Enablement: I'll own trainer notes + localized slide packs. Need the glossary and any UI screenshots.
Oliver - Docs: Screenshot ask noted. Also proposing a single artifact naming convention: toolkit_v{semver}_{lang}_{region}.zip
Samir - Field Eng: Staging infra: we have eu-west and ap-south clusters free for smoke tests. Call out which regions need certs (gov regions require paper KAs).
Maria - Partnerships: @Raj @Denise @Oliver great. Quick checklist draft below (paste for copy):
```
- translations: en -> fr, de, ja, ko
- glossary: finalize 40 terms (ownership: Denise)
- screenshots: update for 1.2 UI changes (Oliver)
- demo images: create light + heavy load variants (Samir)
- regional tests: eu-west, ap-south (Samir)
- gov/compliance: list needed docs (Maria)
- trainer notes: short-runbook + tl;dr (Denise)
- swag/field kits: localization labels (marketing)
```
Oliver - Docs: Small ask: can we version-control screenshots in /si-toolkit/screenshots/1.2/? easier for diffs.
Raj - SI Programs: @Maria I'll run the translation vendor kickoff tomorrow and share memos. For acceptance: 95% string match + 2 SME signoffs per language.
Denise - Enablement: I'll draft the 2-page tl;dr for trainers, will drop into the shared drive by EOD. If anyone wants to co-author, ping me.
Samir - Field Eng: I'll provision eu & ap staging and make a short test script. Can someone confirm which demo load profile we want? light vs heavy?
Maria - Partnerships: Let's run both. Light for quick installs, heavy for perf regressions. Samir add smoke thresholds to the script.
onboarding-bot: Reminder scheduled: "SI Toolkit localization review" in 48h (1756875523).
Oliver - Docs: Noted. Also request: include alt-text for screenshots for accessibility.
Raj - SI Programs: One more: marketplace listing metadata needs localized descriptions. I'll coordinate with product marketing.
Denise - Enablement: If translations lag, we can ship en + localized notes later but trainers need the tl;dr in local language before cohort. Prioritize fr & de first.
Maria - Partnerships: Good call. Action owners summary: Raj=translations+marketplace metadata, Denise=trainer notes+glossary, Oliver=screenshots+artifact layout, Samir=staging+demo images. I'll follow up with calendar invites. :thumbsup: 
Raj - SI Programs: Sounds good. I'll post vendor kickoff notes here after the call.
Maria - Partnerships: Thanks team — aim to close checklist by EOD Friday. If blockers, flag here. :eyes:
